summary: Extracts three Euler angles from a 3x3 row-major rotation matrix: writes the x-angle atan2(-a1[5], sqrt(a1[3]*a1[3] + a1[4]*a1[4])) to this+0, then branches on the FPU status flag (v2 & 0x4100) left by the sqrt. When the flag is set (near-zero cos component, gimbal lock), writes the y-angle atan2(-a1[6], a1[0]) to this+4 and zeroes this+8. Otherwise writes the y-angle atan2(a1[2], a1[8]) to this+4 and the z-angle atan2(a1[3], a1[4]) to this+8. Returns result = v2 & 0x4100 (non-zero when the singularity branch was taken).

local_names.this: output Euler-angle buffer (this+0 = x, this+4 = y, this+8 = z)
local_names.a1: input 3x3 row-major rotation matrix (9 floats, a1[0..8])
local_names.a2: alias for the output buffer base (byte-addressed in the raw source)
local_names.v2: FPU status word whose mask 0x4100 signals the singularity condition
local_names.v4: y-angle value computed in the singularity branch
local_names.result: FPU status word masked with 0x4100, used as the return value

operations.description: Writes the x-angle = atan2(-a1[5], sqrt(a1[3]*a1[3] + a1[4]*a1[4])) to the output buffer at this+0
Computes result = FPU status word & 0x4100 and branches when (v2 & 0x4100) != 0; the flag follows the sqrt in the x-angle computation and marks a near-zero cos component (gimbal lock)
Singularity branch: writes the y-angle = atan2(-a1[6], a1[0]) to this+4 and zeroes this+8 (z-angle) with a dword store
Normal branch: writes the y-angle = atan2(a1[2], a1[8]) to this+4 and the z-angle = atan2(a1[3], a1[4]) to this+8
Returns result = v2 & 0x4100, non-zero when the singularity branch was taken
